title: Delta-Unknotting Number for Pretzel Knots
summary: The $Δ$-unknotting number for a knot is defined as the minimum number of $Δ$-moves needed to deform the knot into the trivial knot. It is known that, for positive pretzel knots, the $Δ$-unknotting number coincides with the second coefficient of their Conway polynomial. In this paper, we compute the $Δ$-unknotting number for positive pretzel knots.
